column1: # Golden-value fixtures for wind_2m_liljegren() (SRDT stability-class estimator).
# Generated by tools/generate-srdt-fixtures.R; do not edit by hand.
# est_speed is the C float result printed with %.9g; comparisons in tests
# use a relative tolerance of 1e-6 to absorb float-vs-double rounding.
# Solar values are at most 925 W/m2 so the C pipeline's top-of-atmosphere
# normalization is the identity for every row (see the test file header).
# Rows with zspeed == 2 are excluded: the original C leaves its
# estimated-speed output unwritten there (documented undefined-output defect).
